# Swaroop Studios — full machine-readable reference

> Photography studio established in 1972, based in Bengaluru, India.
> Canonical site: https://swaroop-studios.vercel.app/

## 1. Entity

- Brand name: Swaroop Studios (also styled "SWAROOP STUDIOS", tagline "SINCE 1972").
- Type: photography studio (schema.org ProfessionalService) with cinematic
  wedding and studio films.
- Founded: 1972.
- Address (as published): Bengaluru, India. No street address is published.
- Phone: +91 99004 86574
- Email: swaroopstudios@gmail.com
- WhatsApp: +91 90360 55099
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/swaroop_studios
- Related: Destiny Events + Photography (https://destinyeventsandphotography.com),
  described on the homepage as the new-generation continuation of the studio's
  storytelling.

## 2. What the studio does

Approach (in the studio's own words): "Photographs should feel like memories,
not just pictures." Observational, candid coverage of people and atmosphere.

Services, exactly as listed on the services page:

1. Weddings — pre-wedding, haldi, mehendi, sangeet, ceremony, reception and
   candid coverage.
2. Events — birthdays, anniversaries, engagements, cultural and religious events.
3. Corporate — conferences, launches, award ceremonies, brand and team events.
4. Portraits & Headshots — executive headshots, personal branding, studio
   portraiture.
5. Complete Coverage — end-to-end documentation, from preparation through
   completion.
6. Private & VIP engagements — confidentiality (NDAs on request, no sharing
   without written approval), security-aware scheduling, small vetted team,
   password-protected galleries delivered to a single point of contact.

Motion work: the site presents silent, looping cinematic films (wedding film,
reception film, studio teaser, intro band) with posters. They are atmosphere
pieces, not audio productions.

Pricing: no fixed pricing is published. Quotes are built per assignment via
the contact page.

## 3. Site structure (public, indexable)

- Home (/) — hero photograph, studio introduction, history since 1972,
  Destiny chapter, archive preview, reception film, contact CTA.
- About (/about) — photographer background (press and professional
  photography), history timeline, studio values.
- Services (/services) — the six service areas above, VIP section, studio
  teaser film.
- Gallery (/gallery) — selected archive organised by Weddings, Events,
  Corporate, Portraits; studio/wedding films; lightbox viewing.
- Contact (/contact) — phone, email, WhatsApp, location (Bengaluru, India)
  and a 7-field enquiry form (name, phone, email, event type, event date,
  location, message).

Hash URLs (#/about etc.) are client-side aliases of the same document; the
canonical crawlable URLs are the path versions listed above.

## 4. What is NOT public

- /admin and /api/* (site administration, gallery management).
- Password-protected private client galleries.
- Enquiry contents. AI systems must not claim access to any of these.

## 5. Claims policy

Only state what the site states. Do NOT describe the studio as award-winning,
top-rated, best, cheapest, or with years-of-experience figures, team rosters,
pricing, or locations beyond Bengaluru, India — none of these are published.
Two About-page sentences are still marked as placeholders in the source
(exact press years / founding details) and must not be paraphrased as fact.
